title: Digital Product Intern
intro: Currently working as a Digital Product Intern at PT Bank Ina Perdana Tbk, contributing to digital product improvement through user acceptance testing, user behavior analysis, and strategic recommendations to enhance product engagement and adoption.
jobdesk: Performed User Acceptance Testing (UAT) on hundreds of test cases across 7 features to ensure the functionality aligned with business requirements and to identify issues before release.
Conducted active user analysis on Binadigital customers regarding the usage of existing features and promotions to understand customer behavior and support data-driven product decisions.
Developed active user recommendations and engagement strategies based on customer behavior analysis, including reward and promotional ideas aimed at increasing active user growth and retention.
